title: Butterfly Contour Memory Foam Pillow, Two Heights, Washable Cover
description: Memory foam pillow with a butterfly shape: a center hollow, a raised neck edge, side wings and arm cut-outs. Two contour heights, 4.5 in and 3.2 in, for back and side sleepers. Removable, washable cover with a hidden zipper. Size 24 x 14 x 5 in. Available in white and grey.

title: 20-Inch ABS Hardshell Carry-On Luggage in Green
description: This 20-inch carry-on suitcase has a durable ABS hard shell in a rich green finish, sized to fit most carry-on limits for short trips. Spinner wheels and an adjustable telescopic handle make it easy to roll through the airport.

title: 20-Inch Hardside Carry-On with 9-Piece Packing Cube Set – Green
description: This bundle pairs a 20-inch ABS hardside carry-on in Green with a 9-piece packing cube organizer set. Roll the spinner-wheel suitcase on your trip and use the cubes, pouches, and bags to keep clothes and small items sorted inside.
